inally by intent, model and host.\n- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get
-one-runs-suite-quality-gate-report.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gat
eable, or not_configured.\n- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enab
le-repoint-or-disable-a-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pin
exactly one of its attached environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omitting
it on a multi-environment suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…\n- [Launch one run per target as a group (a
sync)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/launch-one-run-per-target-as-a-group-async.md): Launches ONE run per target
(attached project environments, or attached named hosts) under a single **server-minted** `runGroupId`, then detaches execution a
nd responds `202` with a per-target receipt.\n- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-author-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite (the suite record plus its test
cases) and responds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST
/eval-runs` (passing the returned `suiteId`).\n- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-eval-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create
one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuiteId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed.
The inspector parses the suite file; this body is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…\n- [Get one eval suite's confi
guration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings: attach
ed environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit
routes read and write.\n- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes
the suite and its cases. Past runs are not deleted.\n- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/ev
al-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a
non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently tre
ated as a clear. Responds with the full updated suite.\n- [List a suite's eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-r
uns/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public steps-first shape.\n- [Create an eval case](https://docs.
mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case to the suite. Both `title` and a non-empty `steps` array
are required: `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but a case persisted without executable steps
could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.\n- [Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 cases to the suite in one call: the bulk form of the s
ingle create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files without a round trip per case. Every entry needs a `tit
le` and a non-empty `steps` array. Cases are validated together and reported individually: a `failed`…\n- [Generate eval cases fro
m the suite's tools](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/generate-eval-cases-from-the-suites-tools.md): Discovers the
suite's server tools over a live MCP connection, generates cases against them, and persists them: the only edit route that connect
s to a server. Synchronous: connect, generate, persist, disconnect, respond.\n- [Author eval cases from a document](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/author-eval-cases-from-a-document.md): The sibling of `cases/generate`: generation invents cases
from the suite's tools, import reads them out of something a person already wrote: a test plan, a spreadsheet of scenarios, a JSO
N export. MCPJam's own model turns the document into full cases (ordered steps, tool calls, assertions), so the c…\n- [Read an eva
l authoring job](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/read-an-eval-authoring-job.md): Progress and drafts for a job sta
rted by `cases/generate` or `cases/import`. Poll this after a `202`, then commit the job once its `status` is `completed`.\n- [Wri
te a finished authoring job's cases into the suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/write-a-finished-authoring-job
s-cases-into-the-suite.md): Writes the job's drafts into the suite. A draft carrying unresolved blocking issues or proposed additi
ons is **skipped** rather than written, and comes back under `skipped` with a `reviewUrl` for finishing it in the app.\n- [Get one
eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-case.md): A case that belongs to this suite and project.
A case in another suite is a 404, not a 403.\n- [Delete an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-ev
al-case.md): Removes the case from the suite. Past runs that executed it are not affected.\n- [Update an eval case](https://docs.m
cpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-case.md): Partial update: omitted fields are left as they are. Supplying `steps`
REPLACES the case's definition rather than merging into it. `matchOptions` and `checks` accept `null` to clear the case-level over
ride and fall back to the suite's.\n- [Upload a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/upload-a-run-artifac
t.md): Stores one artifact referenced by an ingested run (typically widget HTML too large to send inline) and returns the `storage
Id` the run's results then reference. This is what `reportEvalResults` in `@mcpjam/sdk` uses for widget evidence.\n- [Get an uploa
d URL for a run artifact](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-an-upload-url-for-a-run-artifact.md): Retired. Every
request answers `410 Gone` with `code: \"FEATURE_NOT_SUPPORTED\"` and `details.code: \"SDK_UPGRADE_REQUIRED\"`. `@mcpjam/sdk` 8.1
7.0 and later upload a run artifact by sending its bytes to `POST /projects/{projectId}/eval-ingest/artifacts`, which returns the
`storageId` the run's results…\n- [Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-
runs/discover-authenticated-eval-ingestion-capabilities.md): Discover authenticated eval ingestion capabilities. Uses the SDK repo
rting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupported capabilities remain absent.\n- [Persist a
dvisory case-run evaluations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/persist-advisory-case-run-evaluations.md): Persist a
dvisory case-run evaluations. Uses the SDK reporting transport and the same tenant/project authorization as eval ingestion. Unsupp
orted capabilities remain absent.\n- [Ingest a completed eval run in one call](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/ing
est-a-completed-eval-run-in-one-call.md): The whole-run variant: submit a finished run and its iterations in a single request. Thi
s is what the SDK reporter uses by default.\n- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
